scan.title: Point at someone’s invite.
scan.hint: Any QR from an Everglow envelope or link works.

full.title: All {{limit}} spots
full.body: {{host}}’s roll holds {{limit}} people. Ask {{host}} to make room.
full.bodyNoHost: This roll holds {{limit}} people. Ask the host to make room.
full.bodyNoLimit: Ask the host to make room.

notValid.title: This envelope
notValid.body: It may have been reset or mistyped. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.

removed.title: You were removed
removed.body: A host removed you, so this envelope doesn’t admit you. Only a host can let you back in.

closed.title: This roll
closed.body: The gallery closed on {{date}} and its photos were removed.
closed.bodyNoDate: The gallery has closed and its photos were removed.

onHold.title: Joining is
onHold.body: Everglow is reviewing this roll. Try the envelope again later.

suspended.title: This roll
suspended.body: Everglow suspended it for breaking our terms, so no one can join it.

blocked.title: You blocked {{host}}.
blocked.body: To join, unblock {{host}} first. They won’t be told either way.

sealed.title: You’ve been invited
sealed.body: Sign in to open the envelope and see whose it is.
sealed.label: A sealed envelope
